title: ET SCAN SSH Brute Force Login attempt
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects SSH brute-force login attempts via rate of TCP flow openings.
rule_body: alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 22 (msg:"ET SCAN SSH BruteForce"; flow:to_server,established; threshold: type both, track by_src, count 10, seconds 60; classtype:attempted-user; sid:2001219; rev:20;)

title: ET TROJAN Emotet HTTP GET Beacon
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects Emotet HTTP GET beacon check-in pattern.
rule_body: alert http $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET TROJAN Emotet GET Beacon"; flow:established,to_server; http.method; content:"GET"; http.header_names; content:!"Accept-Encoding"; classtype:trojan-activity; sid:2033651; rev:6;)

title: ET EXPLOIT Zerologon Netlogon Auth Bypass (CVE-2020-1472)
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects the ZeroLogon RPC authentication bypass exploitation pattern.
rule_body: alert tcp any any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET EXPLOIT Zerologon Netlogon RPC"; flow:to_server; dcerpc.iface:12345778-1234-abcd-ef00-0123456789ab; classtype:attempted-admin; sid:2031008; rev:3;)

title: ET MALWARE AgentTesla Exfil via SMTP
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects AgentTesla stealer exfiltrating credentials over SMTP.
rule_body: alert smtp $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET MALWARE AgentTesla SMTP Exfil"; content:"Subject|3a| "; content:"Password Recovery"; distance:0; classtype:trojan-activity; sid:2029011; rev:4;)

title: ET POLICY Self-Signed TLS Cert Observed
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects self-signed TLS certificates seen on outbound traffic — evidence, not verdict.
rule_body: alert tls $HOME_NET any -> $EXTERNAL_NET any (msg:"ET POLICY Self-Signed TLS Cert"; flow:established; tls.cert_issuer; content:"CN="; classtype:policy-violation; sid:2027000; rev:2;)

title: ET EXPLOIT log4j JNDI LDAP Reference (CVE-2021-44228)
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects Log4Shell JNDI LDAP lookups in HTTP payload.
rule_body: alert http any any -> $HTTP_SERVERS any (msg:"ET EXPLOIT log4j JNDI LDAP"; flow:established,to_server; content:"jndi:ldap"; nocase; http.header; classtype:attempted-admin; sid:2034649; rev:5;)

title: ET DNS Query with Random Alphanumeric Subdomain (DGA)
author: Emerging Threats
description: Detects DNS queries with high-entropy random subdomains typical of DGA-based malware.
rule_body: alert dns $HOME_NET any -> any any (msg:"ET DNS Query High-Entropy Subdomain (DGA)"; dns.query; pcre:"/^[a-z0-9]{12,}\./i"; classtype:bad-unknown; sid:2025011; rev:2;)
